While my confidence intervals encompass 90% of expected outcomes, there are always specific, high-impact risks or events that could push the actual results beyond these stated ranges. These "black swan" or high-magnitude, low-probability events, while not included in the 90% confidence, always remain a possibility in dynamic environments.
